scientific_integrity: The all-parameter theorem has an analytic proof. An independent integer/finite-field verifier checked the 180 invertible GF(4) matrices and six concrete family instances; finite checks alone do not prove all t. The published papers are referenced accurately and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp threshold is for dimension-two codes and strictly field-linear/monomial equivalence, not semilinear equivalence. Quaternary examples merge under Frobenius; no claim about higher-dimensional codes or code decoding is made. An unindexed equivalent orbit computation remains possible.
title: The first Hamming-isospectral distortion gap among rank-two quaternary codes
